description: Use this when the user asks whether Plain Freight can ship a product from China to the US, or what documents a product needs, before asking for a price. Records nothing. Returns instant_offer (general goods, priced at once), branded_rate (goods with a brand or trademark, priced at once on a higher rate) or person_checks_first (for example batteries, chemicals, food, cosmetics, seeds, vapes or weapons: a person reviews them before any price), with a plain explanation and what to have ready. It applies the same screen as generate_offer, so it predicts what an offer will do; it is not legal or customs advice.

product.description: The product, in the user's words (materials and whether it has a battery help)

name: check_goods

have_ready.description: Documents or details the person will ask for

verdict.description: instant_offer: priced at once; branded_rate: priced at once on the higher branded rate; person_checks_first: no price until a person reviews the goods

title: Check if goods can be shipped
